tests.name: MHPCO premium quotation quotes an empty item list -- premium 5 G (processing fee only)
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a plain sword for a customer with 0 years, first contract -- premium 115 G (100 base + 10 first insurance + 5 fee)
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a plain amulet for a customer with 0 years, first contract -- premium 71 G (60 base + 6 first insurance + 5 fee)
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a plain staff for a customer with 0 years, first contract -- premium 93 G (80 base + 8 first insurance + 5 fee)
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a plain potion for a customer with 0 years, first contract -- premium 49 G (40 base + 4 first insurance + 5 fee)
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a single rune -- base premium 25 G, premium 33 G (25 base + 2.5 first insurance + 5 fee = 32.5, rounded up)
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a single moonstone -- base premium 25 G, premium 33 G (25 base + 2.5 first insurance + 5 fee = 32.5, rounded up)
MHPCO premium quotation quotes 2 runes -- base premium 50 G (no block), premium 60 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes 3 runes -- base premium 60 G (block applies), premium 71 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes 4 runes -- base premium 100 G (no block; block requires exactly 3), premium 115 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes 7 runes -- base premium 175 G (no block at 7), premium 198 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes 2 runes + 1 moonstone -- base premium 75 G (no block: alike means same type), premium 88 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes 3 runes + 3 moonstones -- base premium 120 G (two separate blocks of alike components), premium 137 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a cursed sword -- adds a 50 G curse surcharge to the item base premium, premium 165 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a sword with enchantment 5 -- adds a 30 G high-enchantment surcharge (threshold is inclusive), premium 145 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a sword with enchantment 4 -- no high-enchantment surcharge, premium 115 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a cursed sword with enchantment 5 -- both surcharges apply (50 G + 30 G), premium 195 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a sword for a customer with exactly 2 years with MHPCO -- 20 % loyalty discount applies, premium 95 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a sword for a customer with 1 year with MHPCO -- no loyalty discount, premium 115 G
MHPCO premium quotation applies the 10 % first insurance surcharge to every quote regardless of customer history -- 3-year customer's sword: 100 + 10 - 20 + 5 = 95 G
MHPCO premium quotation applies a 15 % follow-up discount on the customer's second quote -- 3-year customer, cursed sword enchantment 7: premium 160 G
MHPCO premium quotation applies the 15 % follow-up discount on the third quote as well -- 3-year customer, plain sword: 100 + 10 - 20 - 15 + 5 = 80 G
MHPCO premium quotation quotes a cursed sword plus a plain amulet -- policy base 160 G, curse surcharge 50 G (50 % of the cursed item only) = 210 G, plus 16 G first insurance and 5 G fee = 231 G
MHPCO premium quotation rounds a premium of 197.5 G up to 198 G (in MHPCO's favor) -- 7 runes yield 175 + 17.5 + 5 = 197.5

MHPCO premium quotation keeps intermediate amounts as fractions and rounds only the final premium -- 1 rune, 2-year customer, follow-up contract: 25 + 2.5 - 5 - 3.75 + 5 = 23.75 -> 24 G (rounding each modifier in MHPCO's favor first would give 25)
MHPCO premium quotation integration: newcomer (0 years, no previous contract) with a cursed steel sword enchantment 3 -- premium 165 G (100 base + 50 curse + 10 first insurance + 5 fee)

MHPCO premium quotation integration: 3-year customer's second quote, cursed steel sword enchantment 7 -- premium 160 G (100 + 50 curse + 30 high enchantment - 20 loyalty + 10 first insurance - 15 follow-up + 5 fee)
MHPCO claim processing claims a regular steel sword enchantment 3 with damage 500 G -- payout 400 G (full reimbursement minus the 100 G deductible)
MHPCO claim processing claims a rune (insurance value 250 G) with damage 200 G -- payout 100 G (runes have no enchantment level or material, so no special clause applies)
MHPCO claim processing applies the 100 G deductible once per damaged item -- a dragon attack damaging an insured sword (500 G) and an insured amulet (300 G) pays out 600 G
MHPCO claim processing claims a steel sword enchantment 9 with damage 1000 G -- payout 400 G (the 50 % high-enchantment clause applies first, then the deductible)
MHPCO claim processing claims a dragon-material sword enchantment 5 with damage 800 G -- payout 700 G (only the dragon-material clause applies: full reimbursement, then the deductible)
MHPCO claim processing claims a dragon-material sword enchantment 9 with damage 1000 G -- payout 400 G (both clauses apply; the 50 % rule wins, then the deductible)
MHPCO claim processing claims a dragon-material sword with exactly enchantment 8 and damage 1000 G -- payout 400 G (the high-enchantment threshold is inclusive)
MHPCO claim processing claims a steel sword enchantment 7 with damage 1000 G -- payout 900 G (below the high-enchantment threshold, so full reimbursement then the deductible)
MHPCO claim processing reports the remaining cap after a claim -- sword policy (insurance sum 1000 G, cap 2000 G), claim 1500 G -> payout 1400 G, remainingCap 600 G
MHPCO claim processing caps a second successive claim at the remaining cap -- sword policy, two claims of 1500 G: first pays 1400 G leaving 600 G, second pays 600 G leaving 0 G
MHPCO claim processing computes the insurance sum of a sword plus an amulet as 1600 G -- cap 3200 G
MHPCO claim processing computes the cap from unmodified insurance values -- a cursed sword (premium 165 G) still has cap 2000 G
MHPCO claim processing computes the insurance sum of a sword plus 3 runes as 1750 G -- cap 3500 G; the block discount affects the premium only
MHPCO claim processing computes the insurance sum of two swords as 2000 G -- cap 4000 G
MHPCO claim processing treats two sword damage entries against a two-sword policy as separate damages, each with its own deductible -- 500 G each pays out 800 G
MHPCO claim processing rounds a payout of 350.5 G down to 350 G (in MHPCO's favor) -- sword enchantment 9, damage 901 G: 450.5 - 100 = 350.5
claim-office CLI reads a scenario from stdin and writes one result per step to stdout -- amulet quote then a 200 G amulet claim for a 5-year customer
claim-office CLI resolves a claim's policy field as the zero-based index of the quote step that created the policy -- a claim on step 0 draws on the sword policy, not the later amulet policy
claim-office CLI rejects a quote containing an unknown item type -- exits non-zero, writes an error description to stderr, and writes no results to stdout
claim-office CLI rejects a claim whose damaged item is not part of the policy -- an amulet damaged when only a sword is insured: exits non-zero with an error description on stderr
claim-office CLI rejects a claim referencing an unknown item type -- exits non-zero with an error description on stderr
claim-office CLI rejects a claim containing a damage entry with a negative amount (-200) -- exits non-zero with an error description on stderr
claim-office CLI rejects a claim with more damage entries of a type than the policy covers -- two sword damages but only one sword insured: exits non-zero with an error description on stderr
